text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Kh, whoa...!?
What is this, this headache is unbelievable...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Did my mask shrink, desu?
Or did I just yell too much while watching pro wrestling?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I don't understand at aaaaall...!
The bell is just ringing non-stop in my head, deeeesu...!"
choice_data_list: Wanna take the day off today?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pero!
El is not one to let a little headache beat her, no way!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Here I go~...
One, two, three—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh!!!
My own voice echoed, yeeeeees...!
El Condor Pasa seemed to keep her voice down after that, but was plagued by a headache for quite some time...
